$comment: Model routing policy (architecture §6). Config-as-code: this is the GLOBAL layer. client/ and workitem-level overrides deep-merge on top, most specific wins. Every AI call declares its capability; route() picks a tier + budget from here and records a model.routed event when a model is actually invoked. The router itself is rules, not a model — no regress. escalateOn/downgradeOn are lists: ANY entry matching triggers (keys within one entry are AND).

capabilities.$onboarding_comment: Onboarding runs once per repository and leaves files that steer every future session in it for months, so the cost of a mistake is not the cost of the call. Spend by how far an error travels: classify feeds one stage, discover feeds four and the repository, plan decides what exists, validate is the last gate before a client's repo. `complexity` comes from classify, and escalateOn tests >=, so `medium` means a small repository still runs on sonnet while anything larger gets opus — economy where the work is small, quality everywhere else. validate does not escalate: a broken guardrail in a ten-file repository is just as broken, and the artifact count barely moves with repository size.
